statement: Coins stay relevant at every stage of the game and are used in town shop and vault and for home score.
High coin income indicates a well-rounded account because coin gain comes from a very wide range of sources.
Obles give relatively tiny coin gains but are still worth optimizing.
Generally the drop rate oble setup is the best one to use.
Hyper obles occasionally found in the FOMO shop are also good alternatives.
Pop obles can be farmed at Giga Frogs on the world one final map.
None of the other money gain gear armor tools or accessories are worth using; he calls them trash.
Equip prehistoric gear since its stats give the highest money increase in the current meta.
Prehistoric gear is found in the world seven anvil tab.
Research well-dressed nodes need the star or green square shape on; it multiplies the attire's top bonus.
Attire can only be acquired through paid packs so free-to-play players can skip this section.
Well-dressed multiplier also multiplies the attire's bottom bonus even though it does not say so.
Corsair outfit is the best in slot attire for money.
Emerald bling pendant is a massive 200% multiplier obtainable only from the FOMO gem shop shelf and he cannot recall its last appearance.
The often forgotten Draw Breaker prayer at the world three prayer shrine is a monumental buff to coin gains.
You need enough damage to punch through the Draw Breaker curse; a strong Feasty statue and Coin Seekers handle it.
Statues can make up to one third of total coin gains but require hard focus and dedication.
Focus on the Pecunia statue found in World 4 and the Dragon statue found in World 5 hole which boosts Pecunia.
The Dragon statue in the World 5 hole boosts the Pecunia statue.
Rank statues up from gold to Zenith and raise levels into the six or even 700s.
In early World 7 maps Zenith multiplies Pecunia statue and Dragon statue which in turn multiplies Pecunia.
Statue meritocracy further boosts statues for coins.
Green mushroom (G Mush) is by far the biggest coin source and optimizing it is its own guide.
The beginning and end of money discussion is always G Mush.
Fungi Finger Poceter in the lab gives 2% extra cash from monsters per 1 million green mushroom kills.
You can view your green mushroom kill count at the Death Note.
Emerald Rumball jewel increases the Fungi Finger Poceter by an additional 1.6%.
Combined the lab shows a total of 3.6% which multiplies enormously against large coin numbers.
Get gains by killing a metric ton of G Mush.
Maximize kills per hour to make G Mush numbers pop.
Boost kills per hour with the kill per kill alchemy bubble and the kill per kill ballot that rarely comes up in world two.
Kill per kill ballot can be further boosted through equinox and the voters right node.
Mob respawn is the next vector for increasing G Mush kills.
Gear is trash for direct money gains but is useful for respawn.
Easiest respawn sources are the croc chest and legs and divine scarf from world five anvil.
Keychains from dungeon provide respawn and roll up to 12% each.
Use world seven upgrade stones on croc armor to overload mob respawn and do the same on the weapon.
End gamers rock world five gear because of its respawn.
AFK percent is the final part of the trifecta alongside kills per hour and respawn.
A significant portion of AFK percent can be found via golden dumplings dropped by world six crystals.
AFK percent can also be boosted by the arcane blue crystal which acts as a true multiplier.
Getting to 1.3x is a reasonable goal and takes one to two weeks of AFK grinding on AC.
Deathbringer is the class that should be popping candy for G Mush.
Use 12-hour candies for the biggest value because of the candy back guarantee.
Penny of strength in the first tree gives extra coin drops per 250 strength and directly benefits the coin farmer divine knight.
Raise strength via the first second and 17th bubbles and add a prisma if you can afford it.
Deathbringer gains kill per kill per 1000 strength via the charged skulls talent increasing G Mush numbers.
End gamers are in the tens of millions of all stats which makes strength a powerful cornerstone of coin farming.
Golden bread is the food for direct money gains.
Grilled cheese is the food for all stats.
World four meals salad and bundt cake are generally a small portion of total gains.
Put at least a level 10 ribbon on these meals if you are new.
Put at least a level 15 ribbon on these meals if you have been around longer.
Yummy peach ring is the biggest provider of gains since it boosts grilled cheese.
Place your best ribbon on yummy peach ring as it is the strongest meal hands down.
Add as many mastery points to peach ring as you can with at least 10 to 15 and five onto bundt.
Keep your account strong because everything feeds into everything.
